# Easy Bulk Email Validator

- Link: [Easy Bulk Email Validator](https://apify.com/xmiso_scrapers/easy-bulk-email-validator---verify-emails-from-1-7-1000-rows?fpr=p2hrc6)
- Affiliate link: Yes, source link includes `fpr=p2hrc6`
- What it does: Validates scraped or imported email lists using MillionVerifier.
- Best lead gen use cases: Cleaning Google Maps, Apollo-style, directory, and scraped email lists before sending.
- Ideal customer or builder: Agencies, lead sellers, outbound operators.
- Data provided: Email validation result and deliverability-oriented status fields.
- Strengths: Simple hygiene layer for reducing bounces.
- Weaknesses: Validation does not guarantee reply quality, permission, or compliance.
- Best workflow fit: Final QA step before CRM import or outreach tool upload.
- Difficulty level: Beginner.
- Pricing notes: Source title mentions "from $1/1000 rows."
- Example products or automations: Email hygiene microservice, pre-send validation step, lead list QA dashboard.

# EU Amazon Sellers Email Leads

- Link: [EU Amazon Sellers Email Leads](https://apify.com/xmiso_scrapers/eu-amazon-sellers-email-leads?fpr=p2hrc6)
- Affiliate link: Yes, source link includes `fpr=p2hrc6`
- What it does: Provides a database of scraped EU Amazon sellers with emails, phone numbers, and other fields.
- Best lead gen use cases: Ecommerce outreach, seller services, marketplace agency prospecting.
- Ideal customer or builder: Ecommerce agencies, seller tool founders, B2B lead sellers.
- Data provided: Seller records, emails, phone numbers, and related marketplace data.
- Strengths: Faster than building a seller database from scratch.
- Weaknesses: Static datasets need freshness checks and validation.
- Best workflow fit: Seed list for ecommerce campaigns, followed by validation and segmentation.
- Difficulty level: Beginner.
- Pricing notes: Not specified in source.
- Example products or automations: EU Amazon seller list service, ecommerce agency prospect feed, seller audit offer.

# Crunchbase Email Scraper

- Link: [Crunchbase Email Scraper](https://apify.com/scraper-mind/crunchbase-email-scraper?fpr=p2hrc6)
- Affiliate link: Yes, source link includes `fpr=p2hrc6`
- What it does: Finds targeted Crunchbase-related emails by keyword, location, or custom domain inputs.
- Best lead gen use cases: Founder contact discovery, startup outreach, investor-backed company prospecting.
- Ideal customer or builder: Startup-focused agencies, B2B sales teams, data enrichment builders.
- Data provided: Emails, profile titles, bio/source URL style fields where available.
- Strengths: Combines startup/company targeting with contact discovery.
- Weaknesses: Email quality must be validated and compliance-reviewed.
- Best workflow fit: Contact discovery after Crunchbase company selection.
- Difficulty level: Intermediate.
- Pricing notes: Not specified in source.
- Example products or automations: Startup founder email finder, investor portfolio outreach tool, funded account enrichment layer.

# Google Maps Email Extractor

- Link: [Google Maps Email Extractor](https://apify.com/poidata/google-maps-email-extractor?fpr=p2hrc6)
- Affiliate link: Yes, source link includes `fpr=p2hrc6`
- What it does: Collects Google Maps business details and visits related websites to extract emails, phones, and social links.
- Best lead gen use cases: Local outbound lists, agency prospecting, franchise territory research.
- Ideal customer or builder: Local marketing agencies, lead sellers, CRM enrichment builders.
- Data provided: Business details, emails, phone numbers, social media links, JSON/CSV exports.
- Strengths: Combines discovery and contact extraction in one workflow.
- Weaknesses: Website contact data can be incomplete or role-agnostic.
- Best workflow fit: After or instead of a basic Google Maps scrape, before validation and CRM import.
- Difficulty level: Beginner.
- Pricing notes: Not specified in source.
- Example products or automations: "Find dentists in Austin with emails" tool, white-label local lead export service.

# Smart Email Finder and Verifier

- Link: [Smart Email Finder and Verifier](https://apify.com/clearpath/email-finder-api?fpr=p2hrc6)
- Affiliate link: Yes, source link includes `fpr=p2hrc6`
- What it does: Finds and validates professional email addresses using name plus domain pattern discovery.
- Best lead gen use cases: Turning founder, employee, or company records into reachable contacts.
- Ideal customer or builder: Enrichment workflow builders, outbound teams, CRM operators.
- Data provided: Validated professional email, tested patterns, CSV-compatible results.
- Strengths: Combines email guessing with verification and supports bulk CSV workflows.
- Weaknesses: Requires a name and domain; cannot solve incomplete company-only records alone.
- Best workflow fit: After company/person discovery and before outreach sequencing.
- Difficulty level: Beginner.
- Pricing notes: Source says it tests up to 10 patterns and can stop on first match for credit savings; no exact price specified.
- Example products or automations: Founder email finder, CRM missing-email filler, event attendee enrichment tool.

# EU eBay Sellers Email Leads

- Link: [EU eBay Sellers Email Leads](https://apify.com/xmiso_scrapers/eu-ebay-sellers-email-leads?fpr=p2hrc6)
- Affiliate link: Yes, source link includes `fpr=p2hrc6`
- What it does: Provides scraped EU eBay seller records with emails, phone numbers, and other valuable data.
- Best lead gen use cases: Marketplace seller prospecting, ecommerce service offers, reseller research.
- Ideal customer or builder: Ecommerce agencies, marketplace SaaS teams, lead list builders.
- Data provided: Seller records, emails, phone numbers, and related seller fields.
- Strengths: Ready-made list for a defined ecommerce segment.
- Weaknesses: Requires dedupe, validation, and freshness review.
- Best workflow fit: Ecommerce seed list, followed by enrichment, validation, and outreach segmentation.
- Difficulty level: Beginner.
- Pricing notes: Not specified in source.
- Example products or automations: eBay seller prospect pack, ecommerce migration offer list, seller CRM import service.

# Ecommerce Brand Prospecting Tool

- One-line summary: Find marketplace sellers and score them for ecommerce agency or SaaS outreach.
- Customer: Ecommerce agencies, Amazon consultants, seller SaaS companies.
- Pain point: Sellers are spread across marketplaces, and many lists are stale or unqualified.
- Product or service idea: Aggregate seller data, enrich contacts, and rank brands by marketplace activity.
- APIs used: Amazon Seller Data Extractor, EU Amazon Sellers Email Leads, EU eBay Sellers Email Leads, AI Contact Details Scraper.
- MVP feature list: Seller import, category filter, marketplace tags, contact validation, opportunity score, CSV export.
- Monetization model: Subscription, lead packs, or pay-per-export.
- Pricing ideas: $79-$299/month depending on markets and export volume.
- Build difficulty: Intermediate.
- Time to launch: 2-4 weeks.
- Go-to-market idea: Sell to agencies already offering Amazon optimization, ads, listings, or Shopify migrations.
- Why it works: Marketplace sellers often need paid help with growth, operations, and channel expansion.
- Risks / caveats: Static seller datasets need freshness checks and validation.

# Ecommerce Seller Prospecting Engine

- Goal: Find ecommerce sellers and enrich them for agency or SaaS outreach.
- Who it is for: Ecommerce agencies, Amazon consultants, Shopify app founders, marketplace SaaS teams.
- APIs used: [Amazon Seller Data Extractor](../apis/amazon-seller-data-extractor.md), [EU Amazon Sellers Email Leads](../apis/eu-amazon-sellers-email-leads.md), [EU eBay Sellers Email Leads](../apis/eu-ebay-sellers-email-leads.md), [AI Contact Details Scraper](../apis/ai-contact-details-scraper.md), [Easy Bulk Email Validator](../apis/easy-bulk-email-validator.md).
- Inputs: Marketplace, product category, region, seller size indicators, optional target service.
- Outputs: Seller name, storefront URL, marketplace, product signals, contact fields, validation status, offer angle.

## Steps

1. Pull seller records from marketplace sources or seed databases.
2. Filter by marketplace, category, seller rating, product volume, or region.
3. Enrich seller websites or domains for emails, phones, and social links.
4. Validate emails and remove duplicates across marketplaces.
5. Add segmentation tags such as "Amazon-only," "multi-marketplace," or "high review count."
6. Export to CRM or a review queue.

## Why It Is Valuable

Ecommerce sellers buy services for ads, listings, logistics, reviews, storefront design, and marketplace expansion.

## Monetization Angle

Sell seller intelligence, build an ecommerce agency prospecting dashboard, or package niche seller lists.

## Complexity

Intermediate.

# Lead Scoring Model

A simple starter model for ranking leads from the APIs in this repo.

## Core Fields

| Field | Score Idea |
| --- | --- |
| Contact completeness | Email, phone, website, social links |
| Source fit | Maps, directory, job, funding, review, ecommerce, startup |
| ICP match | Industry, location, company size, technology, marketplace |
| Timing signal | Hiring, funding, reviews, recent project post, active marketplace listing |
| Data confidence | Validated email, fresh source, duplicate-free record |
| Offer relevance | Clear reason this prospect needs the offer |

## Example Score

- Contact completeness: 0-20
- ICP match: 0-25
- Timing signal: 0-25
- Data confidence: 0-15
- Offer relevance: 0-15

Total: 100 points.

Use the score to prioritize review and routing. Do not treat it as proof that a prospect wants outreach.
